channel.title: Violations Watch: Honduras
channel.description: New incidents reported in Honduras. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Four coordinated armed attacks in Yorito, Yoro, kill 12 people, including three young children; social-media posts claiming to be from the 'Cártel del Diablo' took responsibility (AFP, CNN en Español, Europa Press)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). El Pacayal and Vallecillo, Yorito, Yoro, Honduras. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Armed group; claimed on social media in the name of the 'Cártel del Diablo' (claim unverified). Reported casualties: 12 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Cartel claim made on social media, not confirmed by authorities. 3 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2729
